integrity.scientific_claim: complete two-customer joint escape law and positive correlation under stated domain
integrity.verification: exact rational and independent finite path simulation corroboration

scientific_limitations: Only the stationary FCFS M/M/1 queue with independently marked original infectious status; two successive arrivals are conditioned both originally susceptible.
Instantaneous exposure (zero contact-time threshold) and no onward infectiousness after exposure; no conclusion for strictly positive thresholds, dependent marks, general service or wider lags.
Finite checks are corroboration, not proofs of general quantifiers; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact two-arrival escape clustering in a marked \(\mathrm{M}/\mathrm{M}/1\) queue
